up.note: Chubb's own media room; Traveloka's own insurance pages say the same but traveloka.com returns 405 from this VM. Kind 'channel' per insurance-distribution convention.

src.title: Traveloka Cooperates with Chubb for Train Travel Insurance
src.note: Chubb's own press release naming PT Chubb General Insurance Indonesia as underwriter of Traveloka travel insurance, cooperation since Dec 2015.

up.quote: Underwritten by PT Chubb General Insurance Indonesia (Chubb), a leading insurer, the train travel insurance is designed to ensure a safe and comfortable journey for train travelers. [...] Traveloka has established its cooperation with Chubb since December 2015 by offering insurance for flights and hotels through the Traveloka website and the Traveloka App.

identity.what: Naming bridge: Chubb's own press release names its Indonesian legal entity PT Chubb General Insurance Indonesia.
